name: Data.exists_squareLaw_grid
summary: `one_square` applied to the four spaces of the grid square, with the tame characters and the cost of one square from `Data.exists_isTameFor_costsSquares_one` for the pair (μ₀ of weight w_{a+1} + w_{b+1}, z = t).

steps.claim: For the pair with the character μ₀(a+1)·μ₀(b+1) (weight w_{a+1} + w_{b+1}, point t, ramified at the chosen places; `Data.mu₀_hasWeight`, `Data.omega_zpow_ne_one`), `Data.exists_isTameFor_costsSquares_one` gives the tameness of the twisted characters for the modulus 𝔪(ϑ, b₁) (x) and the rule T: a function c with |c(ϑ)|² = C·(partial L-value product) costs one square.
steps.lean:
have ⟨x, T⟩ := exists_isTameFor_costsSquares_one ⟨_, D.w _ + D.w _, _, D.t, by
    simpa [← zpow_add] using! (D.mu₀_hasWeight a.succ).mul
      (D.mu₀_hasWeight b.succ), by simp_all, by grind, by simp; grind, by simp; grind
    [w_le_two_mul_b]⟩ (D.omega_zpow_ne_one _) D.b₁ ⟨ite z a b + 1, by grind⟩

steps.claim: `one_square` for the four grid spaces of the square (a, b) → (a + 1, b + 1) of grid z, with the edge families of the grid (`Data.isEdgeFamily_grid`), the rank and sign conditions (sizes bounded by `Data.card_gridIndex_le`, `Data.nat_le_of_hasLogBound`) and the tame characters of step 1; the character conditions remain.
steps.lean:
have := one_square (D.gridSpace 0 z a b) (gridSpace ..) (gridSpace ..) (gridSpace ..)
    (isEdgeFamily_grid id false rfl) (isEdgeFamily_grid id _ rfl) (isEdgeFamily_grid _ _ rfl)
    (isEdgeFamily_grid _ _ rfl) (Fintype.equivOfCardEq ?_) ?_ D.t ?_ ?_ (by simp; grw
    [card_gridIndex_le, card_gridIndex_le, (D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound : D.n _ ≤ D.h₂)] <;> grind) x ?_

steps.claim: From it: constants C, κ, c(ϑ) with c(ϑ) ≠ 0 (n), |c(ϑ)|² = C·(L-value product) (hc), and the square identity H.
steps.lean: choose C κ c n hc H using this

steps.claim: Take κ, the identification σ of the square, c as a nowhere-zero function; c costs one square by T and hc; the character condition is put last.
steps.lean: use κ, ?_, (.mk0 _ <| n ·), T hc, fun ϑ l ↦ ?_; swap

steps.claim: The square law for ϑ and l is H, once the characters agree: the product of the two edge characters is the inverse of the product of the characters in H.
Equality of the two products of local characters, factor by factor (`finprod_mul_distrib`, finite supports).

The remaining character and rank identities, for both grids: unfold the grid characters (`Data.gridChar`, `Data.liftChar`, `Data.liftTamePart`), the sizes (`Data.card_gridIndex`), the twist powers and the numbers of negative signs (`Data.card_neg_gridSigns`), and compare.
steps.lean:
all_goals clear * -; cases z <;> intros <;> (try apply_fun Additive.ofMul) <;> simp_all [gridChar,
    liftChar, liftTamePart, card_gridIndex, rankTwist, TameChar.pow, twist_one_spec,
    card_neg_gridSigns, show (1 : D.Twist).ψ = 1 by rfl] <;> first | match_scalars <;> grind | grind

steps.claim: The tame part of the trivial twist is 1.
steps.lean: show (1 : D.Twist).ψ = 1 by rfl] <;> first | match_scalars <;> grind | grind
